claim.claim-text: a light-transmissive substrate configured to propagate light via total internal reflection, and a coupling element comprising a metasurface and a diffractive optical element, the coupling element configured to couple light into or out of the light-transmissive substrate such that the coupling element deflects a plurality of wavelengths of the light collinearly.

2. The optical waveguide of claim 1, wherein the metasurface is formed on or proximate to a first surface of the light-transmissive substrate, and the diffractive optical element is formed on or proximate to a second surface of the light-transmissive substrate.

3. The optical waveguide of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the metasurface is configured to deflect the plurality of wavelengths of the light towards the diffractive optical element and the diffractive optical element is configured to further deflect the plurality of wavelengths of light for propagation within the light-transmissive substrate.

4. The optical waveguide of any preceding claim, wherein the diffractive optical element is configured to deflect the plurality of wavelengths of the light toward the metasurface and the metasurface is configured to further deflect the plurality of wavelengths of light for propagation within the light-transmissive substrate.

5. The optical waveguide of any preceding claim, wherein the metasurface is a first metasurface, the optical waveguide further comprises a second metasurface, and the diffractive optical element is configured to deflect the light in a first direction towards the first metasurface and in a second direction towards the second metasurface.
6. The optical waveguide of any preceding claim, wherein the metasurface comprises a plurality of nanostructures with a spacing on the order of a sub-wavelength of the light.
7. The optical waveguide of claim 6, wherein the plurality of nanostructures comprises one or more of a nanofin, nanopillar, nanoantennae (i.e. V-shaped), nanorod, or nanowire.
8. The optical waveguide of claim 7, wherein the nanopillars comprise a circular or elliptical cross section.
9. The optical waveguide of claim 6, wherein the metasurface comprises a resonant grating.
10. The optical waveguide of any preceding claim, wherein the metasurface comprises two or more layers.
11. The optical waveguide of and preceding claim, wherein the diffractive optical element comprises one or more of a surface relief grating, a Bragg grating, or a volume grating.

12. The optical waveguide of any preceding claim, wherein the coupling element is a first coupling element and is configured for in-coupling of light into the light-transmissive substrate for propagation, and wherein the optical waveguide further comprises a second coupling element configured for out-coupling of the light propagated through the light-transmissive substrate.
a display module configured to output an image; and an optical waveguide according to any preceding claim.

14. The NED of claim 13, wherein the coupling element is a first coupling element and the optical waveguide further comprises a second coupling element such that the first coupling element is configured for in-coupling and the second coupling element is configured for out-coupling.
15. The NED of claim 14, wherein the first coupling element is configured to be located above an eye of a user when the NED is worn.
